summary:
**MISSION FORGOTTEN** is an immersive 3D space exploration platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, focusing on storytelling about abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars.

The project allows users to explore the Moon and Mars through a cinematic space shuttle experience. Users can select interactive locations and historical objects, triggering smooth camera movements that bring them closer to each discovery. The experience presents mission information, historical descriptions and photographs, supported by integrated NASA data and mission resources.

MISSION FORGOTTEN addresses the challenge by transforming the stories of forgotten space equipment into an interactive visual journey. Rather than simply reading about past missions, users can explore discoveries and understand the purpose, history and significance of equipment left behind during space exploration.

Developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js, WebGL, Python and Flask, the project combines real NASA information with immersive 3D visualization and interactive storytelling.

This project is important because abandoned space equipment represents valuable milestones in human exploration and scientific achievement. By preserving and sharing these stories, MISSION FORGOTTEN aims to make space history more accessible, encourage scientific curiosity, promote space education and inspire future generations to explore beyond Earth.
